payload.answer:
Across disclosed returns from 1998-99 to 2025-26 in OPAX’s published selection, Westpac Banking Corporation provided the most disclosed funding to One Nation: $161,787.

- Australian Hotels Association (NSW) provided disclosed funding: $126,996.

- National Australia Bank provided disclosed funding: $19,715.

- Registered Clubs Association of NSW (t/as ClubsNSW) provided disclosed funding: $3,000.

These disclosed party receipts include more than gifts and cover only the published selection; undisclosed receipts below the disclosure threshold make totals a lower bound, rather than an exhaustive industry total or personal payments, and a donation is not evidence that it influenced a vote or speech.
